question: ip-proxy/host-asn-field-absent: decide whether extras.asn_by_host.racknerd.own_asn (none registered to the name) holds, given that ARIN RDAP entity search with the wildcard fn=RackNerd* answers 200 with entity records named RackNerd.
why: On 2026-11-02 the exact-name queries fn=RackNerd, fn=DediRock and fn=VolpaByte answered 404, and RIPEstat searchcomplete listed no ASN for the three names. The wildcard fn=RackNerd* answers 200 with 258 entity records (252 named RackNerd LLC, the others RackNerd datacenter, abuse and NOC records and one private-customer record), none with an autnum link in the answer; fn=DediRock* and fn=VolpaByte* answer 404. An ARIN customer entity is not an ASN holder, but whether an ASN is registered to those entities was not checked, and ARIN RDAP has no ASN search by name.
